title: Invoices arrive in the mailbox
intro: Suppliers send invoices to the invoice mailbox: PDFs, e-invoices and one scanned paper invoice. Here it is a local test mailbox; in a company it is their normal Outlook or Gmail.

notes.t: Every new mail is picked up
notes.d: A small workflow checks the mailbox every minute and hands each attachment to the invoice check.

notes.t: Two invoices arrive twice, on purpose
notes.d: The e-invoice RE-2026-1219 is sent again, and RE-2026-1187 comes back as a copy further down. One of each pair should be stopped as a duplicate; step 2 shows what this run did.

title: Accounts gets one mail per invoice
intro: The subject already says the verdict, the supplier, the invoice number and the amount: “Buchbar” (ready to book), “Abweichung” (difference) or “Gestoppt” (stopped).

notes.d: Twelve invoice mails, three verdicts. Only the differences and the stops need a person to read further. This run checked the invoices in parallel, so three verdicts differ from the test table: the copy of RE-2026-1187 got Buchbar and the original Gestoppt, and LW-50288 found two open orders (see Limits).

title: An invoice with a price difference
intro: This supplier charged more than agreed in the purchase order.

notes.d: One price is 7.2 % above the order. The tolerance is 2 %, so the invoice is flagged.

notes.t: Order, receipt and invoice side by side
notes.d: Ordered, delivered, already billed and billed now, for every line. Only the cell that breaks a rule is marked.

notes.t: The expected next step is the filled button
notes.d: Send the drafted query to the supplier. Booking anyway and discarding are there too. Nothing happens before a click.

title: The query to the supplier is already written
intro: For a difference, the AI drafts a short, factual e-mail to the supplier: the numbers, what is wrong and what is needed.

notes.d: It goes out only after the click on “Rückfrage an Lieferanten senden”. The invoice stays a draft in Odoo until the correction arrives.
Tolerance, fixed checks, how the document was read and which AI was used. The AI runs locally here, so no data leaves the machine.

title: A changed bank account stops everything
intro: The invoice asks for payment to a new bank account. That is one of the most common invoice frauds, so this invoice is not even drafted.

notes.t: Compared with Odoo, not with the e-mail
notes.d: The account on the invoice is shown above the one stored in Odoo, in groups of four. The advice is to call a number already known, never to reply.
Only “Als erledigt markieren”. A stopped invoice cannot be booked from here by mistake.

title: E-invoices are read by Odoo itself
intro: XRechnung and ZUGFeRD invoices carry their data inside. Odoo Community reads them, so no AI is needed; the automation adds the checks around it.

notes.d: Order, goods receipt and invoice agree; sums, VAT ID and IBAN were checked. Booking is the filled button.
“E-Rechnung (XRechnung UBL), von Odoo selbst eingelesen, ohne KI”. PDFs are read by the AI, paper scans by OCR first.

title: The draft bill in Odoo
intro: The invoice from step 3 (LW-50231) as a draft vendor bill in Odoo; it stays a draft while the query to the supplier is open. Odoo's interface runs in English here; the company data is German.

notes.d: The bill points to order P00002, so Odoo's own reports see what was ordered, received and billed.
The 20.90 price stays as the supplier billed it. The bill stays a draft while the query to the supplier is open.
A note on every bill says which file and which mail it came from.

title: A complaint, decided by rule
intro: A customer writes that the display was cracked on arrival and wants her money back.

notes.d: Order, product, delivery date, warranty, amount with VAT. The AI only read the e-mail; these values come from Odoo.
The original e-mail is shown, so the person who approves can check what the AI understood.
A credit note of 141.61 € is prepared in Odoo and the reply is written in the company's tone.
Approve books the credit note and sends the reply. Reject cancels the draft and sends nothing.

title: The company sets the rules
intro: A plain form, no code: how replies are written, how complaints are decided and which AI is used. Every field shows the value in use; a choice marked “(aktuell)” keeps it.

notes.d: Language, Sie or du, tone, length, when to apologise, closing and signature.
A local model, a cloud provider, or the AI key already set up in Odoo. The form says where the data goes. Keys stay in a local file, never in this form.
